name: What is involved in a custom shower design project with AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in a custom shower design project with AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: A custom shower design project with AKN Design Group involves a comprehensive, managed process. We begin with a detailed consultation to understand your vision, lifestyle, and aesthetic preferences. This leads to CAD-supported layouts and material selections, where we explore options like walk-in showers, frameless glass enclosures, custom tile surrounds, rainfall fixtures, and integrated storage solutions. Our integrated design-build approach ensures seamless coordination from concept to installation, culminating in a spa-inspired retreat tailored to your specifications. The process prioritizes clear communication and a single point of coordination, ensuring your design vision aligns with construction execution.
acceptedAnswer.description: AKN Design Group offers a managed, integrated design-build process for custom showers, from initial consultation and CAD layouts to material selection and final installation, creating a spa-inspired retreat.
